cross_family.single_g_note: SINGLE_G_OXYGEN_RESPONSE: one r for every family (O2); a family cannot declare a more or less oxygen-responsive G at the same impairment

DO2.kind: relative to normal through the arrival layer
DO2.readers: deficit, D, lactate, acid burden, sympathetic acute term, encephalopathy, collapse
DO2.writers: derived.relative_delivery (output x Hb ratio x SpO2 ratio) x arrival_delivery_ratio

G.writers: none ('guard only; no module writes G yet')

L.writers: core: derived.congestion_rate (excess preload above the knee x (1 - reserve x P)) and lung_water_clearance (first order toward arrival, only above it); family: ACS IschaemicCongestion

PaCO2.writers: derived.respiration (P2K-2: resting / ventilation, anchored to the arrival PaCO2); P2K-3 closure: reference / W

RR.writers: derived (P2K-1 RR, or P2K-2 intrinsic + S(1 - exp(-drive / S)) with the acid drive)

SpO2.readers: delivery (relative_delivery), sympathetic hypoxaemia term, consciousness level (oxygen_levels), encephalopathy hypoxaemia signal; collapse only through delivery
SpO2.writers: derived (_perfusion): arrival SpO2 + spo2_per_fio2 x the oxygen benefit over arrival, cap 100

W.kind: channel: deviation; computed W: ratio to need
W.readers: the channel: only the pre-P2K-2 RR (derived.respiratory_rate); with the acid-base physiology on, derived.respiration reads no W channel
W.writers: none (channel); P2K-3 ventilation.ventilated_respiration computes an effective-ventilation W (capacity / demand) that is not the channel

acid_burden.writers: integration._acid_burden (deficit_to_acid_gain x effective deficit, first-order clearance)

oxygen_content.writers: none as a state: Hb x SpO2 inside relative_delivery (dissolved O2 not modelled)

design.compatible: O1-O6 are compatible with the channel domains: L and G are already deviations from arrival on [-10, 10] with no reader of G, SpO2 is derived in one place (derived._perfusion) and every reader of oxygenation reads it there, collapse reads delivery only, and the respiratory closures read neither L nor G

decided.O1: L remains a dynamic deviation from arrival: L = 0 is the authored arrival lung state (arrival congestion may already exist), L > 0 worsening, L < 0 improvement only if the channel domain allows it safely; arrival anchors are not changed to give L an absolute meaning
decided.O2: G is one common gas-exchange impairment coordinate; shunt, V/Q mismatch and diffusion are not split (latent contributors to one effective G); a single-G causal contradiction across families stops the package
decided.O3: the common path is L -> G -> oxygenation -> oxygen content / DO2; L writes no SpO2, DO2, D, lactate, RR, W, consciousness or collapse
decided.O4: L -> G is monotonic, non-pathological, zero at L = 0 (arrival), never improves gas exchange when L worsens; clinical gain and thresholds UNSET; synthetic structural values for probes
decided.O5: no NIV in P2O-1 (a future treatment-composition task)
decided.O6: no direct SpO2 collapse input; collapse sees respiratory failure through oxygen delivery; P2M-2 unchanged

deferred.alveolar_gas_hypoxaemia: ALVEOLAR_GAS_OXYGENATION_DEFERRED: hypoventilation raises PaCO2 but lowers no SpO2 (no alveolar gas equation; a faculty decision, TASK 3 (3))
deferred.dynamic_mechanics: W_MECHANICS_DYNAMIC_WRITER_NOT_AVAILABLE: with the acid-base closure on, no channel carries a dynamic ventilatory mechanics; the probes use the P2K-2 structural efficiency (static)
deferred.family_oxygen_response: SINGLE_G_OXYGEN_RESPONSE: one r for every family (O2); a family cannot declare a more or less oxygen-responsive G at the same impairment
deferred.hypoxaemic_drive: HYPOXAEMIC_DRIVE_DEFERRED: SpO2 reaches RR only through delivery and the acid burden
deferred.pao2: PAO2_NOT_REPRESENTED: no dissociation curve; SpO2 is the oxygenation observable

design.fio2: FiO2 adds spo2_per_fio2 (ADOPTED, 30 points per unit) x its benefit over room air, scaled by the share G keeps; the arrival FiO2's benefit is part of the authored arrival SpO2, so a patient who arrived on oxygen loses part of it as G worsens, and a FiO2 rise always helps
design.form_decision: NOT_A_SUBSTANTIVE_CHOICE: the selected form is the shared first-order term of the plausible forms; every eliminated form adds an unidentifiable shape parameter, a threshold O4 forbids, a new state, or an unbounded credit O1 leaves unrepresented. Curvature, lag and improvement below arrival stay UNSET for the faculty

lagged.form: dG_L/dt = (k x max(0, L) - G_L) / tau
lagged.why: needs a new state for the L share of G and a second time constant: L's own writers and clearance already carry the dynamics; tau is unidentifiable without authored courses

linear_first_order.why: the first-order term every smooth monotone L -> G with G(0) = 0 shares; continuous, monotone, zero at arrival, no threshold, one explicit gain, inactive at L = 0

power.why: n unidentifiable without authored courses; n = 1 is the selected form

saturating.why: reduces to the selected form to first order; L_half is a curvature with no authored data (unidentifiable); the SpO2 mapping is already bounded

symmetric.why: an improvement below arrival needs a bound, the arrival congestion's share of the arrival impairment, which O1 leaves unrepresented; any bound would be a new clinical value

threshold.why: needs a clinical threshold (O4: none) and is inert over a range of worsening lung water

design.identifiability: only k x s is identifiable from a lung-water course at room air; s alone from a family that writes G; r only from an oxygen response; none is identifiable from the current authored truth (arrival only)

oxygenation.at_arrival: exact: at G = 0 the expression is the core's SpO2 term by term
oxygenation.below_arrival: G < 0 changes nothing (no credit below the arrival reference, as for L)
oxygenation.content_and_delivery: unchanged: delivery = output x Hb ratio x SpO2 ratio (dissolved O2 not modelled); PaO2 stays NOT_REPRESENTED (no dissociation curve)
oxygenation.effective_shunt: 1 - retained(G): internal to the mapping (CANDIDATE / UNSET), never a shunt or V/Q state
oxygenation.incomplete_response: retained(G) = 1 / (1 + r G) falls toward 0 with a severe G, never reaching it; r = 0 keeps the full FiO2 response (a purely V/Q-like G)
oxygenation.monotone_in_FiO2: dSpO2/dFiO2 = spo2_per_fio2 x retained(G) > 0 above room air: never paradoxically worse
oxygenation.monotone_in_G: dSpO2/dG = -s + spo2_per_fio2 x benefit(FiO2) x d retained / dG <= -s < 0 for G > 0 (both terms non-positive), whatever the arrival FiO2
oxygenation.structure: SpO2 = arrival SpO2 - s x max(0, G) + spo2_per_fio2 x (benefit(FiO2) x 1 / (1 + r x max(0, G)) - benefit(arrival FiO2)), benefit(F) = max(0, F - 0.21), clamped to [0, 100]
oxygenation.ventilation: reads no ventilation, PaCO2, RR or acid burden: oxygenation impairment stays separable from ventilation; hypoventilation reaches PaCO2, not G

oxygen_response_loss_per_gas_exchange_un.note: its effective shunt-like share is CANDIDATE / UNSET

probes.O1: L = 0, G = 0: the arrival oxygenation (and every derived reading) is the core's without P2O-1
probes.O10: lactate and D rise with G fixed: G unchanged
probes.O11: L improves back toward arrival: G never worsens; L below arrival moves no G
probes.O12: GI with L = 0: every respiratory and downstream reading is exactly the one without P2O-1
probes.O2: L worsens (a declared lung-water drift): G never improves and equals k x max(0, L)
probes.O3: G worsens with the ventilation fixed: oxygenation worsens
probes.O4: G worsens with PaCO2 fixed: oxygenation worsens independently of ventilation
probes.O5: FiO2 rises with a fixed mild G: oxygenation improves
probes.O6: FiO2 rises with a severe G: the improvement is incomplete, never paradoxically worse
probes.O7: RR changes (the intrinsic RR) with W and G fixed: the oxygenation path does not change
probes.O8: W changes (the structural efficiency) with G fixed: PaCO2 changes, G and SpO2 do not
probes.O9: the acid burden rises with G fixed: G unchanged

design.recommendation_rule: Predeclared. With READY: A (CARDIOGENIC_CONGESTION_GENERATION) when the cardiogenic L -> G -> SpO2 chain acts only on a family-written L, i.e. the common P / V coupling still produces no lung water in the frozen P2N-2 fluid probe (COMMON_CONGESTION_GENERATION_GAP open); B (RESPIRATORY_TREATMENT_COMPOSITION) when the common coupling already produces L there; C and D are outside what P2O-1 can show and are never chosen by it

semantics.G: the effective gas-exchange impairment relative to arrival (O2, P2O-1C): G = 0 is the arrival gas exchange; a worse G never improves oxygenation; G changes no ventilation; L may raise it (the core coupling) and a family may write it through other mechanisms; no disease is named in it
semantics.L: lung water / congestion change: a dynamic deviation from the authored arrival lung state (O1); its own writers and clearance; it reaches oxygenation only through G
semantics.RR: the respiratory drive's observable rate (P2K-2): reads no L, G or SpO2 (no hypoxaemic drive in P2O-1)
semantics.SpO2: the result of gas exchange G and inspired oxygen, anchored to the authored arrival
semantics.W: ventilatory capacity / effective ventilation relative to need: unchanged by P2O-1 (P2K-2 / P2K-3); reads no L or G and is read by no oxygenation term
semantics.acid_burden: metabolic acid physiology (P2K-2): produced by the effective oxygen deficit, read by HCO3 and the drive; never written into or read from G

semantics_before.G: deviation from arrival ('shunt / V-Q impairment'); no writer, no reader
semantics_before.L: deviation from arrival; read by nothing but its clearance
semantics_before.W: channel: deviation; computed W: ratio to need

verdict_criteria: L, G and W causally distinct (boundaries, O3, O4, O7, O8)
hypoventilation occurs independently of G (O8, opioid)
pneumonia and PE use G without cardiogenic L
metabolic acidosis needs no G (O9, metabolic acidosis)
consciousness coherent (one SpO2, its hypoxaemia signal monotone)
no clinical value approved (every new value UNSET by default, SYNTHETIC_ONLY in probes)

O8.deferred: ALVEOLAR_GAS_OXYGENATION_DEFERRED: hypoventilation raises PaCO2 but lowers no SpO2 (no alveolar gas equation; a faculty decision, TASK 3 (3))
